cards.title: Parenting the Emotionally Intense Child
cards.body: Children express emotions in dramatic ways that need understanding and support. Learn strategies to help emotionally intense kids flourish and manage their feelings effectively.

cards.title: Co-Regulation: Rhythm Helps Children and Adults
cards.body: From lullabies to work songs, rhythm helps humans co-regulate at home and at work. Understanding co-regulation supports emotional development across all ages.

cards.title: Modernizing Nursery Rhymes for 21st Century
cards.body: Updated nursery rhymes promote social, emotional, and cognitive benefits for contemporary children. Modernizing often antiquated lyrics makes them relevant and engaging for young learners.

cards.title: When the Bully Is an Adult
cards.body: Adults can be bullies toward children, and identifying these behaviors is crucial. Addressing adult-child bullying helps change the culture of interactions and protects young people.

cards.title: School Anxiety Harming Children's Futures
cards.body: A landmark report reveals how school anxiety is preventing children from attending classes. The BBC interviews school avoiders and experts working to fix this growing issue.

cards.title: Why Some Teenagers Don't Go to School
cards.body: Teenagers describe the overwhelming anxiety that prevents them from attending school. Understanding school refusal helps parents and educators address this serious mental health challenge.

cards.title: My Son's Back Home After Graduation
cards.body: Adult children returning home after university create new parenting dynamics. Adjusting expectations and building healthy household relationships becomes essential for family harmony.

cards.title: Type 1 Diabetes: A Father-Son Journey
cards.body: England player Henry Slade reflects on being diagnosed with type 1 diabetes and his father's lifelong management of the condition. Parental support and understanding make childhood diagnoses less frightening.
